content.title: Guardians vs. Mariners: Prediction, Lineups, How to Watch (3/26)
content.text: The Cleveland Guardians visit the Seattle Mariners tonight at T-Mobile Park in the final Opening Day matchup of the 2026 MLB season. Logan Gilbert takes the mound for the defending AL West champions, making his second straight Opening Day start as Seattle looks well-positioned to repeat atop the division. He enters off a solid 2025 campaign, going 6–6 with a 3.44 ERA while striking out 173 batters in 131.0 innings, despite a first half limited by injury. Seattle’s lineup remains anchored by elite power, led by 60-home run man Cal Raleigh and Julio Rodríguez. Josh Naylor returns to bolster the middle of the order, and while Eugenio Suárez departed for Cincinnati, the addition of Brendan Donovan makes up for some of the offense, minus the power. Tanner Bibee gets the Opening Day nod for Cleveland, looking to rebound from a 2025 season in which he posted a career-high 4.23 ERA — a step back from his standout rookie campaign in 2023, when he finished with an ERA under 3.00. Bibee, however, was lights out during Cleveland’s spectacular September run, going 3–0 with a 1.30 ERA while striking out 26 over 27.2 innings. The Guardians rode that dominant stretch to a stunning late-season turnaround, erasing an 11-game deficit in early September to seize control of the AL Central. Cleveland’s rotation will again be asked to carry the load after an offseason that brought minimal upgrades to a lineup that still ranks among the less imposing groups in the American League. The Mariners have the edge here with Gilbert on the mound and one of the fiercest offenses in the major leagues. Prediction: Seattle Mariners 6, Cleveland Guardians 3 Starting Lineups Cleveland Guardians Steven Kwan — LF Chase DeLauter — RF José Ramírez — 3B Kyle Manzardo — DH Bo Naylor — C Rhys Hoskins — 1B Daniel Schneemann — CF Gabriel Arias — SS Brayan Rocchio — 2B Starting Pitcher: Tanner Bibee — RHP Seattle Mariners Brendan Donovan — 3B Cal Raleigh — C Julio Rodríguez — CF Josh Naylor — 1B Randy Arozarena — LF Luke Raley — RF Dominic Canzone — DH Cole Young — 2B Leo Rivas — SS Starting Pitcher: Logan Gilbert — RHP How to Watch Guardians vs. Mariners First pitch is scheduled for 10:10 PM Eastern / 7:10 PM Pacific at T-Mobile Park in Seattle. The game airs live locally on Mariners.TV and Guardians.TV and streams for out-of-market viewers on MLB.TV.
